# gandi_dnssec_keys (Data Source)

List the DNSSEC keys registered for a Gandi domain, e.g. to find the id of a key added in the dashboard before importing it as a `gandi_dnssec_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gandi_dnssec_keys" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# Import ids for keys added in the Gandi dashboard.
output "dnssec_key_ids" {
  value = [for k in data.gandi_dnssec_keys.example.keys : k.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain (FQDN) to list keys for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain.
- `keys` (Attributes List) Keys registered at the registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) IANA DNSSEC algorithm number.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the DS record.
- `digest_type` (Number) Digest type of the DS record.
- `id` (String) `<domain>/<key_id>`, usable as a `gandi_dnssec_key` import id.
- `key_id` (Number) Gandi's numeric id for the key.
- `keytag` (Number) Key tag of the DS record.
- `public_key` (String) Base64 DNSKEY public key.
- `type` (String) `ksk`, `zsk` or `none`.
